In French.

At the [Rencontres R 2025](https://rr2025.sciencesconf.org/), Mons. How `_brand.yml` gives Quarto documents a consistent visual identity, in HTML and in PDF with Typst, with light and dark themes, and how the same file is reused by Shiny and bslib. The example is a fictional company, Pulse Mobile.
